items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: A corporate website usually takes 3–5 weeks, while e-commerce and custom platforms take 6–12 weeks. The exact timeline is confirmed in a written schedule once requirements are set.

items.question: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. Delivery includes one month of free technical support, followed by optional monthly support and growth packages.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: Payment is split into milestones: an initial deposit, an interim milestone and a final payment on delivery. All terms are agreed upfront in the contract.

items.question: Do you handle hosting and domains?
items.answer: Yes. We select hosting and domains that fit the project and take care of setup, SSL certificates and migration end to end.

items.question: Will my site be optimised for SEO?
items.answer: Every project ships with technical SEO in place: semantic HTML, speed optimisation, metadata, structured data and an automatic sitemap.

items.question: Is mobile compatibility guaranteed?
items.answer: All projects are built mobile-first and tested separately on phone, tablet and desktop screens.

seoText.label: SEO text
seoText.title: The right technology partner for digital success
body: At H2 Solutions we apply current technologies and effective strategies so businesses can hold a strong position in the digital world. Web development, mobile applications, e-commerce solutions, SEO and business automation together increase the online impact of your brand.

An architecture built on Next.js and Laravel gives your website both speed and durable visibility in search results. Technical SEO, structured data and GEO — optimisation for AI-driven search engines — mean your brand is found not only on Google but across AI platforms as well.
We treat every project as a long-term partnership: from analysis to design, from code to continued support, we contribute to your business at every stage.

usp.label: Why us
usp.title: Why H2 Solutions?
usp.subtitle: Three pillars our digital practice is built on:

items.title: Delivered on time
items.description: We hand over on the agreed date and show you what is ready every week — the project is never a black box.

items.title: Measurable results
items.description: The goal isn't a pretty website, it's enquiries and sales. We track what works in numbers and share the report with you.

items.title: Hands-on partnership
items.description: No templates — every solution is built around your business. We work one-on-one with each client.

servicesPreview.title: Our services
servicesPreview.subtitle: From the first line of code to sustained growth — we cover the full cycle.

services.title: Services
services.intro: From websites and mobile apps to SEO and business automation — six core services for growing your business online.
services.startText: Questions about this service? Send a short brief and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

items.question: How do we know which service fits us?
items.answer: A free initial consultation reviews your business goal, your current digital setup and your budget. You receive a written proposal stating which services are worth taking and in what order.

items.question: Can several services be combined?
items.answer: Yes. Web development, mobile apps, SEO and automation can be planned as a single project, which simplifies integration and lowers the overall budget.

items.question: We already have a website — does it need rebuilding from scratch?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We start with a technical audit; improvements to speed, SEO and design are often enough. A full rebuild is recommended only when the underlying technology is out of date.

items.question: How is the price determined?
items.answer: The price depends on scope, integrations and the number of languages. We prepare a fixed-price offer from your brief, so no unagreed cost appears mid-project.

items.question: When can you start work?
items.answer: Usually within 3–5 working days of signing the contract. For urgent projects we allocate a parallel team.

items.question: Who owns the project after delivery?
items.answer: You do. All code, the domain, hosting and admin access are handed over in full, together with documentation and a training session.

seoText.label: SEO text
seoText.title: Digital services managed by a single partner
body: H2 Solutions brings web development, mobile applications, e-commerce, SEO and business automation together under one roof. Instead of coordinating several suppliers, you work with one team that knows the whole system — from the database to the interface your customers see.

Every service is built to the same engineering standard: Next.js and Laravel architecture, mobile-first interfaces, measurable page speed, technical SEO and structured data. That is why a site we deliver stays fast and visible in search results long after launch, and works for AI-driven search as well.
Our work does not stop at delivery. Analytics, content, ongoing SEO and new feature development continue as monthly packages, so your digital product keeps pace with your business.

about.label: About us
about.title: About H2 Solutions
about.subtitle: One brand, one promise: quality and altitude.
about.story: H2 Solutions is the agency Hamid Hamidli built on technical perfectionism and business outcomes. We treat every project with an owner's mindset — building solutions that don't just work but generate revenue.
about.storyTitle: Digital work that performs, not just looks good
storyParagraphs: H2 Solutions is a technical agency based in Baku, building the online foundation of small and mid-sized businesses. The “H2” in our name stands for two simple commitments — high quality and height: taking every project one level above where we found it.

It started with one question: why do so many websites look great yet bring in no customers? The reason, we found, is that business logic and technical execution are usually planned apart. So we start not with design, but with your goal, your competitors and real search demand.

Today we deliver corporate websites, e-commerce platforms, SEO/GEO and business automation projects on Next.js and Laravel. We stay after launch too: measuring, learning and planning the next step together with you.
